en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5559 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

'A man bequeathed thirty dinars to the descendants of Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her. The man brought the money to Abu Abdullah (as), who said: "Give it to such-and-such an elder from the descendants of Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her," and that man was poor and struggling to provide for his family.

The man responded: "But the deceased specifically bequeathed it to the descendants of Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a}." Abu Abdullah (as) replied: "It will not have the same impact on the descendants of Sayyidah Fatimah {s.a} in general, but it will have a meaningful impact on this man, for he has a family to support."
